preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Treasury Maturity Ladder'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT r.currency_code AS currency, r.id AS run_id, l.bucket_seq AS bucket_seq, l.bucket_code AS bucket, l.source, l.line_code AS line, l.product_name AS product, l.contractual, l.behavioural, l.inflow, l.outflow, l.net, l.cumulative_gap FROM m_treasury_run r JOIN m_treasury_run_line l ON l.run_id = r.id WHERE r.run_type = 'LADDER' AND r.office_id IS NULL AND r.as_of_date = '${asOn}' ORDER BY r.currency_code, l.bucket_seq, l.source, l.line_code, l.id

column.name: description
column.value: The institution maturity ladder runs of a date: every line per bucket, with each bucket's net and cumulative gap.

column.name: report_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT id FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Treasury Maturity Ladder')

column.name: parameter_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT id FROM stretchy_parameter WHERE parameter_name = 'asOnDate')
